proposition.claim:
Recorded check: The lattice sum-kernel assumptions permit deterministic connectivity, falsifying Theorem 2.4

Recorded check: The introductory negative-Omega lower-tail statement has the wrong direction

Recorded check: All-size lower bounds fail at logarithmic and lattice endpoints

Recorded check: The claimed short-edge boundary exponent includes an edgeless threshold case

Recorded check: A low-endpoint edge event is used as if the full component had low marks

Recorded check: Palm deletion is incorrectly treated as losing only one vertex of a component

Recorded check: The conditional law in(A.7) reveals the wrong mark bands

Recorded check: The auxiliary monotonicity claim for g fails on an allowed logarithmic row

Recorded check: The cover expansion invocation omits s(w)>n

repair.content:
Require p<1 or beta*kappa(1,1)<1, with the close-to-one mark cutoff adjusted in the lattice proof; for kappa_sum require p<1 or2^d beta<1. Propagate the restriction to Theorem2.4 and the kernel comparison.

Replace Omega by O in the introductory lower-bound formulation, or separately state and prove any intended restricted upper bound.

State sufficiently large k and sufficiently large n depending onrho, with the nondegeneracy correction inP1; separately control any finite values actually claimed.

Qualify the boundary claim with a positive crossing-edge mechanism or state the edgeless case separately.

Retain the component-wide low-mark restriction from(6.19), or define the relevant short component in the low-mark induced graph and adjust the event consistently.

ChooseK withP0(D0>K)<rho/2, combine with(7.2), deleteorigin, obtain ordinary largest component>=(rho*n-1)/K with probability>=rho/2; enlarge outer box by a fixed factor and adjust constants.

In(A.7) replace low graph byG_n[w_hh,2w_hh), retain stated lowest-band/origin conditions; correct minus sign in(A.18).

Replace monotonicity justification with the stated fixed-constant comparison and treat the other rows directly.

Add thiscase, increase fixedminimumk asneeded, retain exp[-c*k*w_hh^(-(tau-1))] from the same thinning.
